meta.name: Library minimal case: one tenant, one site, one BESS (SYNTHETIC)
meta.description: P5.20 scenario-library minimal case: the smallest replayable scenario — one tenant, one portfolio, one site, ONE BESS asset, 24 h horizon, 15-minute telemetry cadence, one master seed with the recorded per-asset derivation rule. All behaviour is SYNTHETIC with stated assumptions — not validated physical models; all emitted telemetry is simulation-only (0.x line). The behaviour profile (bess_daily_cycle) and its parameters are the recorded Phase 2 profile family evaluated at fixture scale; the schema is byte-compatible with the Phase 2 exit-gate artefact (scenario-v2.json). Expected outcomes are PRE-REGISTERED in the library record that pins this fixture and in ledger/phase-05-operator-console-simulator/18_20_replay_library.md — written before any run (UNRUN at authoring time).

portfolio.market_region_note: Label only (P2.02): market region must not drive market logic; D1 is open.

sites.timezone_note: Display-only metadata (P0.09); canonical timestamps are UTC on the scenario clock.
sites.reactive_note: Declared per site (P0.07 s3; P2.04 D-T4): this convention travels on every reactive-power record; Q > 0 means injection.

pcc.grid_model_note: Reference only - the grid model fixture is declared per library record (P5.20); no IEEE feeder is used or claimed (19.3 discipline).

assets.capability_note: Reference only - capability-profile contents are Phase 3 (P2.02 step 6).

behaviour_profile.assumptions: Synthetic rectangular-efficiency daily dispatch; no electrochemical, temperature, degradation, or state-of-health model; constant efficiency; no auxiliary consumption; instantaneous power transitions; availability constant true.

horizon.clock_note: The scenario clock is deterministic simulation time (P0.09 s5), distinct from wall-clock time. Window and curve times are scenario-clock UTC.

cadence.default_note: 15-minute telemetry cadence for the minimal library case (96 ticks over the 24 h horizon) - the smallest replayable volume; the scheduling-grid interval is pinned per library record (P5.03 defaults: 24 h / 15-min).

seeds.derivation_note: One master seed plus the recorded per-asset derivation rule (D-SC4), identical to the Phase 2 exit-gate artefact.

faults.note: The minimal case carries no fault injections (the stress cases are separate library records, P5.20).
